critique.evidence: Reduced-motion proof is strong across desktop, tablet, and mobile: the media query matches and the hero remains at opacity 1 with no transform. Normal-motion start and end states are measurable, but the sampled midpoint is effectively identical to the end state at every viewport, so smooth interpolation and easing are not demonstrated. Tablet/mobile timing is near 60 fps with no long frames, while desktop averages 22.36 ms per frame and reaches 50 ms.
critique.fix: Capture several evenly spaced in-animation frames showing meaningful progression between the start and end states. Adjust duration/easing or measurement synchronization so the midpoint is genuinely intermediate, and optimize the desktop animation to stay near a 16.7 ms frame budget without 50 ms spikes.
